dialogue.realtalk: Talk. Sure. It passes the time until it doesn't.
dialogue.realtalk.checkin.good: Good enough. The rain held off. That's as good as it gets.
dialogue.realtalk.checkin.rough: Every day is a heavy few days, %1$s. But thank you for noticing this one.
dialogue.realtalk.day.good: Nothing went wrong yet. I'm keeping my expectations where they belong.
dialogue.realtalk.day.rough: The usual. Grey sky outside, greyer one in here.
dialogue.realtalk.work.like: It keeps my hands busy so my head can't wander. That's worth something.
dialogue.realtalk.work.hate: Does anyone like their work? Or do we all just agree not to ask.
dialogue.realtalk.life.first: My life is a long corridor of Tuesdays, %1$s. But there were a few Sundays. I'll tell you about those.
dialogue.realtalk.dreams.first: I used to dream big. Now I dream the roof doesn't leak. Aim small, miss small.
dialogue.realtalk.fears.first: That the best days already happened and I wasn't paying attention.
dialogue.realtalk.feelings.first: You make the corridor of Tuesdays feel shorter. Don't make me repeat that.
dialogue.realtalk.regrets.first: Regrets are the only thing I collect. Pick a shelf, any shelf.
dialogue.realtalk.deflect.personal: No. Some cellars stay shut, especially for strangers.
dialogue.realtalk.deflect.intimate: You want the deep water? You haven't even gotten your boots wet, %1$s.
dialogue.realtalk.gossip.none: Nothing happens here. That's the whole tragedy of the place.
dialogue.realtalk.us.happy.yes: Happy is a strong word. Content, though. Dangerously close to happy. Because of you.
dialogue.realtalk.us.worries.open: Everything weighs, love. But since it's you asking... sit. I'll share the heavy end.
dialogue.chat: A talk. Why not. The silence was getting smug anyway.
